### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Stop pulling the reader back down while a turn streams](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3228) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — While an agent's answer streams in, you can scroll up a session to read without being pulled back down. Scrolling back to the end, pressing End or sending a message follows the answer again; the Create agent assistant does the same.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update dependency concurrently to v10.0.6](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3237) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
